English: Frontier Hamlet
A cluster of makeshift huts, earthworks, and communal fires, hastily assembled by the first settlers on the open plains.
Plains Croft
A handful of sturdy timber dwellings, small barns, and palisaded yards primarily supporting subsistence farming on the steppe.
Fenced Pasture
Expanded grazing fields enclosed by wooden fences, providing modest security and support for livestock herds and a growing population.
Wheat Field
Broad fields of wheat provide both surplus food and taxable grain, supporting a larger settlement and expanding local muster rolls.
Open Field System
A network of communal fields, crop rotation, and water management, allowing for a thriving rural economy and larger peasant levies.
Manor Farm
The estates manorial heart, with stone walls, granaries, and workshops, offering security and vast agricultural output for both lord and levy.
Cattle Yard
Large wooden stockyards and byres shelter cattle herds, greatly increasing local prosperity and the ability to feed and equip men-at-arms.
Farmstead
A concentrated agricultural settlement, with stone barns, granaries, and a fortified enclosure, supporting both defense and prosperity on the open plains.
Plains Estate
A sprawling estate with multiple manorial farms, fortified halls, and organized villages, commanding the open country and its resources.
Barons Demesne
The full baronial domain: a fortified manor, administrative courts, granaries, armed retinues, and a thriving hub of rural life, projecting power across the open plains.
